cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women with preterm labour compared to 120 pregnant women with full-term deliveries.
finding: Gastrointestinal disturbances, hyperlipidaemia, and SIBO-positivity were found to be significantly higher and positively correlated with preterm birth in pregnant women experiencing preterm labour.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during pregnancy, with SIBO levels observed at different time points.
